claims: The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix brought Formula 1 to downtown Phoenix on March 14, 2026.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix featured high-speed runs, donuts, and drifting on Jefferson Street.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix was free.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix was family-friendly.
Phoenix hosted the Phoenix Grand Prix from 1989 to 1991.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix location was Downtown Phoenix, specifically East Jefferson Street from South Central Avenue to South 5th Street.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix featured an Oracle Red Bull Racing F1 car.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix featured a Visa Cash App Racing Bulls car.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix featured a Ford F-150 Lightning SuperTruck.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix featured a Ford Mustang GT4.
Patrick Friesacher performed at the Red Bull Showrun Phoenix.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix included high-speed, burnouts, and smoke-filled 360-degree turns performed by the cars, according to 12News.
The Red Bull Showrun Phoenix involved significant road closures on Jefferson Street and surrounding areas starting early on March 14, reported by azcentral.com.
